source.author: verg
source.text: Sic pater ille deum faciat, sic altus Apollo, incipias conferre manum.
source.text_original: 'Sic pater ille deum faciat, sic altus Apollo, / incipias conferre manum.'
source.text_english: So may that father of the gods make it happen, so may lofty Apollo, that you begin to join hands.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Sic pater ille Deum faciat: sic magnus Iesus.
reuse.text_original: Sic pater ille Deum faciat: sic magnus Iesus.
reuse.text_english: So may that father make God; so may the great Jesus.
